standard.name: MIABE (Minimum Information About a Bioactive Entity)
standard.abstract: Reporting guideline for bioactive entities (small molecules, therapeutic proteins, peptides, antibodies, carbohydrates, drugs, herbicides, pesticides, nutraceuticals) and their interactions. Intended as a minimum checklist of information to include in publications or data depositions to enable repeatability, curation and data mining; covers molecule identity, production, physicochemical properties, in vitro assays, cellular assays and whole-organism studies. Records are typically tabular/textual metadata accompanying publications or database entries describing bioactivity.

classification.rationale: MIABE is presented as a minimum reporting checklist and sample MIABE file (tabular mapping of criteria to data sources) and thus is best represented as a metadata table of required fields (the supplementary material provides a 'Sample MIABE file exemplifying data extracted' in tabular form).
